verdict.rationale: ROS 2 ships a well-documented official CLI (ros2) with numerous subcommands (topic, bag, security, node introspection, etc.), described as the main entry point for command-line interaction with the ROS graph and explicitly extensible for building custom verbs/tools. Missing for 10: independent evidence of AI-agent-specific integration (e.g., structured/JSON output modes) and explicit framing of the CLI for autonomous/agentic use rather than human operators.
